svg.text: A Redis queue, structured logging and data quality rules, tested locally with Docker Compose.
One CSV per site per hour
Null, or unchanged for 3+ hours: row kept
with is_flagged = TRUE and one WARNING
speed = -1: speed row not written; flow
row and bucket file kept; WARNING logged.
More than 10 in an hour: one ERROR.
Lost if Redis restarts; the database
